snippet.title: DROP DEAD PARTY - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Drop Dead Party is a chaotic party game where you and your friends play tag with bombs. A fast-paced multiplayer PvP game for Steam, built entirely around 4-player online chaos with no public lobbies. Just you and your friend group.

Pass the ticking bomb before it explodes. Drop dirty power-ups on your friends. Survive fast-paced, chaotic circus rounds, and try not to ruin your friendships in the process....

🎮 Key Features
- 2-4-players online multiplayer! Steam friends-only, no public matchmaking. Every match is personal!
- Fast-paced tag gameplay with a ticking bomb
- 4 tactical sabotage power-ups: Banana Peel, Shield, Rocket, Deployable Wall
- Chaotic circus-themed battle arenas
- Built for game nights, party games, and friend group chaos

Perfect for gaming night on Discord!
